subject: Mingcheng - Perception pipeline
text:
Hi [NAME],

Congrats on your new role as Head of Perception at Tensor! Saw you're
scaling the team - hope recruiting's going well.

Given your Lyft partnership, I imagine things are moving fast with
hundreds of robocars streaming from thousands of sensors - syncing,
labeling, and QAing multi-modal data can get complicated. We're many
AV/ADAS teams moving from multi-stacks (CVAT, Voxel 51, Segments +
services) toward a single data platform like Encord to consolidate
annotation, QA and model eval.

Quick context: Encord is a data layer scale up ($50M Series B backed by
Nex47 & YC) supporting 200+ AI teams like Boston Dynamics, Woven (Toyota),
Physical Intelligence, Nexar, and Motive to improve training data quality
and automate annotation at scale.

Would love your take on what we're built for AV/ADAS. How's your calendar
looking like next week Tue - Thu PT?

subject: [NAME] - AI/ML Ops
text:
Hi [NAME],

I noticed your career grew from data engineer to machine learning engineer
at [COMPANY] - impressive journey! Thought I'd reach out as we recently onboarded
LVT and Flock Safety to help them streamline training data pipelines and
integrate AI agents into workflows.

Many smart camera and surveillance teams hit the wall when real-world
training data outgrows tools like Voxel51 - billions of CCTV frames and
edge cases quickly become tough to manage. That's why we're seeing teams
shifting from multi-tool stacks (CVAT, Voxel 51, Segments + Services) to
Encord, consolidating workflows across curation, annotation, QA, and model
evaluation.

Quick context: Encord supports 200+ AI teams (Boston Dynamics, Thinking
Machines Lab, Protex, Voxel, etc) to automate annotation and improve
training data quality at scale, especially for VLM and GenAI use cases.

Would love your feedback on what we've built. I'm flexible Tue - Thu in the
coming weeks if you're open to chat.
